final_evidence.text: The fictional Varn Opera House seats nine hundred people.
The fictional Composers Guild of Varn meets every autumn.
Glass Orchard is a fictional opera written by the composer Ansel Brighe. It premiered at the Varn Opera House.
Fictional orchard songs are sung at harvest festivals.

Fictional opera sets are often painted on canvas.
